description: Election Commission - Arumairaththinam Satheeswaran was eleted as the member of the ward 06 - Sivankoviladi of Valvettithurai Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Valvettithurai Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
